t: Signature Review Checklist for AI Code
title: Signature Review Checklist for AI Code
description: The Signature checklist reviews every AI diff: runs clean? edge cases (empty batch, device transfer)? no hardcoded paths? seeds set? dtypes correct? tests updated? The checklist is a card (and a demo) — reviewers work through it instead of skimming. 'Usually right' becomes 'verified right' via the list.

demo.program:
checks = ["runs clean", "edge cases", "no hardcoded paths", "seeds set",
          "dtypes correct", "tests updated"]
print("Review card:")
for c in checks:
    print(f"  [ ] {c}")
print("'Usually right' -> 'verified right': via the list, not skimming.")

title: Signature Debugging Playbook
description: The Signature playbook for AI-assisted debugging: reproduce first, paste full traceback + shapes + versions, ask for root cause BEFORE fix, apply one fix at a time, re-run to verify. The playbook is a card — debugging stays methodical instead of becoming prompt-and-pray. Root cause before fix: the rule that prevents whack-a-mole.

demo.program:
print("1. reproduce 2. traceback + shapes + versions 3. ask ROOT CAUSE first")
print("4. one fix at a time 5. re-run verify")
print("Card on desk: methodical, not prompt-and-pray. Root cause BEFORE fix.")

title: Signature Eval-First Development
description: The Signature practice writes the eval BEFORE the model change — baseline metric recorded, then the AI implements the idea, then the eval re-runs. Improvements are measured, not felt. The eval harness template ships in the project template. 'I think it's better' is not a result; the delta is.

demo.program:
print("Eval FIRST: baseline recorded -> AI implements -> eval re-runs.")
print("Improvements measured, not felt. Harness in project template.")
print("'I think it's better' != result. The delta is the result.")

title: Signature Offline Fallback Plan
description: The Signature plan for AI-editor outages (or air-gapped work): VS Code with the same extensions and settings, snippets for common scaffolds, and the prompt library's non-AI checklists. The workflow degrades gracefully — slower, but never stopped. Dependence on the AI is managed, with a practiced fallback.
